NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera is used to scan the booking QR code at check-in.
NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Face ID is used to unlock your account securely.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The microphone is used to record the doctor's visit dictation and turn it into a draft clinical note.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is checked only when you clock in or out, if your clinic uses a radius around it.
